categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main segments: new energy battery business and surface engineering chemicals business. The new energy battery segment focuses on lithium-ion battery R&D, production, and sales, including energy storage batteries and systems, as well as integrated EPC services for photovoltaic and energy storage solutions. The surface engineering chemicals segment produces coating additives and intermediates used in automotive, machinery, electronics, coatings, construction, shipbuilding, and aerospace industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced lithium-ion battery technologies with a focus on high safety, long life, and low cost. It has established multiple specialized laboratories for materials, cells, modules, and system integration, supporting rapid industrialization of new technologies. The surface engineering chemicals segment emphasizes green, clean, and energy-saving chemical formulations, adhering to ISO9001 and IATF16949 quality management standards. Production is organized based on customer orders and market demand, with strict quality control and lean manufacturing practices.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include downstream surface engineering processing enterprises and coating additive manufacturers, as well as clients in the new energy sector such as new energy vehicle manufacturers and energy storage system users. The company serves automotive, machinery, electronics, construction, shipbuilding, aerospace, and renewable energy industries. Major markets include domestic industrial and commercial energy storage, residential energy storage, and overseas residential energy storage sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant sales in South China, East China, and Central China regions. It also has a growing presence in overseas markets, particularly in residential energy storage. The headquarters and major production facilities are located in Hunan Province, with historical roots in Guangdong Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the lithium-ion battery supply chain, focusing on battery cell production, module assembly, system integration, and providing comprehensive EPC services. It also produces chemical additives and intermediates upstream for surface engineering applications. The company maintains strategic supplier relationships to ensure raw material supply stability.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on expanding its energy storage battery and integrated system business, emphasizing technology innovation in high energy density, safety, and long cycle life batteries. It invests in R&D collaborations with universities and research institutes, developing diversified products for residential, commercial, and large-scale energy storage applications. The company also aims to build a leading smart energy management platform and enhance its EPC service capabilities in photovoltaic and energy storage integration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of lithium-ion batteries, energy storage systems, and surface engineering chemical products. The company also earns income from integrated EPC services in the new energy sector, including design, procurement, construction, and maintenance. Other revenue sources include sales of battery scrap materials, technical service fees, and operational maintenance services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces intense competition in the new energy battery market, particularly in the power battery segment, leading to a strategic shift towards higher-margin energy storage batteries and systems. It positions itself as a technology-driven provider with a diversified product portfolio and integrated service offerings. In the surface engineering chemicals sector, it competes with smaller players, leveraging its scale, quality certifications, and green product development to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 125.6 million, a 33.98% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 394.5 million, reflecting ongoing financial challenges and asset impairments. The company’s total assets stood at approximately RMB 1.46 billion with a net asset value of RMB 162.8 million. Despite revenue decline, the company is investing in R&D and capacity expansion, particularly in energy storage, aiming for future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its core competitive advantages in technology innovation, product safety, long battery life, and cost efficiency. It offers diversified energy storage solutions tailored to various application scenarios, supported by strong R&D capabilities and quality management systems. Its integrated EPC services and smart energy management platform provide customers with comprehensive, one-stop renewable energy solutions, differentiating it from competitors focused solely on product manufacturing.
